items.fdcDescription: Rice, white, long grain, unenriched, raw
items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts USDA raw unenriched white long-grain rice as a bounded nutrition reference for rinsed/washed basmati rice. Basmati is a long-grain rice, but the retained USDA record does not certify basmati cultivar, aroma, geographic origin, enrichment status of a particular brand, or residual rinse water. This binding is limited to rice that is rinsed/washed and still uncooked; soaked, cooked, brown, mixed-grain, and alternative-rice identities remain separate. Nutrition remains per 100 g raw grain; no cooked-yield or water-absorption conversion is inferred.
